note: Five content pillars from Surafel's master brief (25 Oct 2026). Weekly targets are for 14 feed posts. The old tone-audit lanes (strategy/18-tone-rebalance) map in via 'from_lanes'.

human_mind.name: The Human Mind
human_mind.covers: Neuroscience, neuroplasticity, psychology, behaviour, cognition, emotional intelligence. Stoic reframes of hurt and struggle live here.

good_life.name: The Good Life
good_life.covers: Altruism, kindness, generosity, friendship, relationships, community, ethical living, appreciation and awe.

reading_room.name: The Reading Room
reading_room.covers: Books, literature, philosophy from every tradition, authentic reviews, intellectual debates, recommendations.

living_body.name: The Living Body
living_body.covers: Fitness, strength, cardiovascular health, nutrition, longevity, sleep, evidence-based wellbeing. Never body image.
living_body.disclaimer: General education, not medical advice. Check with a doctor before changing exercise, diet or medication.

forgotten_knowledge.name: Forgotten Knowledge
forgotten_knowledge.covers: Historical medicine, Chinese dynasties, Mongolian traditions, Ethiopian and African intellectual history, al-Andalus, herbal traditions, ethnobotany.
forgotten_knowledge.disclaimer: Historical interest only, not medical advice. Some traditional remedies are toxic.
